decisions.reason: The spring-controlled flap weir builds directly on the firm's existing mechanical water-control knowledge, allowing it to interpret early results and improve the product.
The energy management system requires software and control expertise distant from the firm's core machinery knowledge, limiting its ability to assimilate results and improve the product.
The overflow flap gate is closely related to the firm's established water-level regulation equipment, and its dedicated website presence suggests stronger early results.
